rungs.title: Assistant Editor
rungs.summary: Learning the edit workflow, formats and the house style.
rungs.knowledge: Knows the editing software, codecs, formats and the brand's video style.
rungs.delivery: Assembles rough cuts, syncs audio and exports to spec, under supervision.
rungs.leadership: Organises files so anyone can pick up the project and asks for feedback early.

rungs.title: Video Editor
rungs.summary: Cuts finished videos from brief to delivery.
rungs.knowledge: Fluent in pacing, sound, colour, captions and platform formats.
rungs.delivery: Takes footage and a brief to a finished video on time, with light review.
rungs.leadership: Works with producers and designers; explains edit decisions.

rungs.title: Senior Video Editor
rungs.summary: Owns the story and the quality of a series or campaign.
rungs.knowledge: Deep in storytelling, motion and AI-assisted tools; sets the standard for finishing.
rungs.delivery: Owns the edit of a campaign or series and its consistency.
rungs.leadership: Mentors editors and negotiates scope with the people who ask for the work.

rungs.title: Lead Editor
rungs.summary: Runs the edit pipeline and the team.
rungs.knowledge: Designs the pipeline, templates and review process.
rungs.delivery: Plans the team's output and owns turnaround and quality.
rungs.leadership: Leads editors and works with marketing and content on the plan.

rungs.title: Head of Video
rungs.knowledge: Connects video to brand and results across channels.
rungs.delivery: Owns the video budget, strategy and output.
rungs.leadership: Leads leaders and speaks for video at executive level.
